prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the EXACT existing Ascend Studio desktop workspace, authoritative for layout, navigation, information density, text, and content. Create a realistic, production-quality visual refinement of this same screen, not a new product. Target dimensions: 1280 x 720, same aspect ratio as input. Current date anchor: 2026-10-09; do not add dates.
Preserve the three-column structure EXACTLY: compact grouped projects/tasks at left, active conversation in the middle, independent movable code and evidence objects on a free canvas at right. Preserve new task, automation tasks, capability library; existing project/task names and dense spacing. No Learning Center, no learning group label. Branding: Ascend Studio, not Codex. AI answers remain plain text on the page background, NO AI chat bubble and NO avatars. User message is in a restrained bubble aligned to the right. Preserve compact text sizes and the original Chinese UI content; do not enlarge type or reduce information to create whitespace.
Use the existing palette: warm white #ffffff, warm pale gray #f7f6f3, neutral selected #f2f2f0, text #25252a, dividers #e8e7e4, extremely restrained cool periwinkle blue-violet #707b9f. Crisp thin separators, nuanced matte/translucent surfaces, refined tiny shadows, precise typography and carefully lit small illustrations. Keep the same hierarchy, action controls and canvas cards. Do not add panels, features, metrics, tabs or banners; use spacing and subtle surface polish first. No saturated selection, no left accent border, no outline/glow on text.
Primary request: introduce clearly COMPUTATION-related, sophisticated decorative imagery in several small, useful locations while making the dense workspace feel more polished. These are decorative motifs, not new controls or technical claims. Integrate a small main illustration in the free whitespace at the task-canvas header, a tiny related motif near the sidebar footer, and an extremely subtle structural background motif only in blank canvas margins, never behind readable text. Decorative imagery should occupy approximately 5-8% of the screen, natural scale, not a big marketing hero. Content remains dominant.
Avoid: pearls, jewelry, gemstones, glossy balls, floating spheres, bubbles, ring ornaments, ribbons, toy objects, mascots, flowers, random lifestyle metaphors, neon cyberpunk, dark gaming UI, rainbow glow, heavy gradients, overly rounded chunky shapes, oversized empty cards. No device frame, no browser chrome, no concept title or option number printed on the image.
Direction: Tensor slices and tiled computation.
Design the decorative family from a refined three-dimensional tensor: 3-4 THIN square translucent plates, each etched with a fine MATRIX GRID, offset slightly to expose their indexable structure. Rectangular data tiles and a few tiny cool periwinkle edge cells show partitioning and a tail boundary. These must read as tensor blocks and computation surfaces, never as jewelry or stacked glass coasters. Use engineered straight edges, slight bevels, matte satin graphite/white, shallow translucent optical depth, soft studio side lighting, meticulous small shadows. Main header art about 86 x 68 pixels; a tiny 4 x 4 tile silhouette by the sidebar footer; a faint cropped matrix lattice at canvas edge. Enough texture and dimensional detail to feel crafted, with very limited color. Retain all existing interface content exactly and polish its surface finish.

Direction: Parallel computation and measured execution traces.
Build a refined mostly TWO-DIMENSIONAL technical decorative system from a compact precise array of parallel execution bars, stair-step discrete signal traces, coordinate tick marks, and tightly spaced rectangular data strips. Use two or three ultra-thin translucent sheets with subtle alignment offsets to create a little tactile depth. The main canvas-header vignette feels like a beautifully made miniature profiling trace or compute scheduler sheet, with discrete lanes and one tiny blue-violet verified segment. No large 3D block sculpture, no generic semiconductor chip, and no smooth luminous ribbon. Small related parallel strips in the sidebar footer and a faint grayscale engineering lattice at the blank canvas margin establish a quiet visual rhythm. Make this direction editorial, orderly, and visually sophisticated, with precision print-like micro-details, soft matte surfaces, fine shadows and restrained optical layering. These are ABSTRACT decorative traces only, not new data charts or fabricated performance claims. Preserve the existing three columns, the exact Chinese conversation, code object, evidence object, dense sidebar and neutral selections.
